name: Battery chargers and charge circuits
summary: Battery chargers and charging circuits for lead-acid, lithium and NiMH, from wall plugs to workshop units.
uses: Recharging batteries from mains, a generator or an inverter
USB charging for phones and lights
identify: Wall chargers for tools, phones and radios; car battery and float chargers in garages; built-in chargers in UPS units, golf carts, scooters and floor scrubbers. The label gives output voltage, current and chemistry.
test: Measure the open output: lithium chargers show about 4.2V per cell, lead-acid ones 13–15V for 12V. Connect a battery and check that current flows and the battery voltage climbs.
